spans.s:
हंस॑ f. ई goose, also applied to the swan, flamingo and
like water-fowl;
 fig. the sun, the soul, du. the individual and
universal soul.
हंसगति* f. moving (gracefully) like a swan.
हंस˚गामिनी f. moving (gracefully) like a swan.
हंसचन्द्रांशु m. pl. sun- and moon-beams.
हंसतूल n. the down of a geese.
हंसपदिका f. N. of a woman.
हंसमाला f. a flight of wild geese.
हंसमुख f. ई shaped like the beak of a goose.
1 हंसयान n. a team of geese.
2 हंसयान f. ई riding on a goose.
हंसराज m. a big gander (lit. a king of geese).
हंससा॑चि m. a kind of bird.
हंसावली f. = हंसमाला.
हंहो a. vocative particle.
2 हन् f. घ्नी (—˚) killing, slayer.

ह॑नन a. (f. ई) & n. striking down, killing,
destroying.
ह॑नीयंस् (compar.) slaying more or most.
ह॑नु f. the jaw.
हनूमन्त् m. = हनुमन्त् m.
हनुमन्नाटक n. T. of a drama.
ह॑न्त interj. come! go to! well! often repeated or w. हा.
हन्तव्य a. to be killed.

ह॑न्तु m. killing (हन्तुम्, ह॑न्तवे, ह॑न्तवै॑ & ह॑न्तोस्
infin. to हन्).
हन्तुकाम a. wishing to kill.
हन्तृ॑ (gen.) & ह॑न्तृ (acc.) slaying, slayer.
ह॑न्त्व a. to be slain.
ह॑न्मन् s. stroke, blow.
हान n. leaving, giving up, wanting, ceasing.

हानि f. abandonment, relinquishment, want, privation,
decrease, detriment, damage, loss, ruin.
हानिकर a. causing loss or damage.
हानि˚कृत् a. causing loss or damage.
